lead: `peek.py` takes its options *after* its targets, and mixing them is "unrecognized arguments" naming a target that is perfectly well formed.
body: The positional list is `nargs="*"` and closes at the first flag, so `peek.py A.rs:re:x --window 4 B.rs:re:y` fails on `B.rs:re:y` and reads as a malformed target; re-quoting, escaping the `::` and dropping `re:` all fail the same way. Put every target first and every `--window`/`--in` last.
